objectives.title: Make fleet and forklift detail a complete engineer workflow
acceptance: Fleet cards open the correct forklift detail record
Forklift detail exposes customer, site, identity, hours, status and due dates
Forklift detail links useful job and compliance history
Loading, empty and error states are truthful

objectives.title: Make the jobsheet workflow complete and reviewable
acceptance: Jobs can be created with customer, site, forklift, work details and evidence
A saved job reloads with its evidence and signature
Job status can be reviewed and completed safely
Important save failures are visible to the engineer
constraints: Do not fabricate OCR or AI results

objectives.title: Complete service and LOLER compliance workflow
acceptance: Service and LOLER events can be recorded
Completion updates the appropriate next due date safely
Compliance history is visible from forklift detail
Forklift documents can be attached and retrieved
constraints: Do not invent certificates or documents

objectives.title: Complete parts and supplier workflow
acceptance: Parts can be created and maintained
Supplier orders and lines can be recorded
Supplier lines can be linked to jobs
Job parts show quantity and cost context
constraints: Preserve supplier paperwork as source evidence

objectives.title: Persist quotes and invoices with safe human review
acceptance: Invoices persist to Supabase
Totals and VAT calculate consistently
Invoice status supports human review
No customer invoice is automatically sent

objectives.title: Improve paper and voice job capture without inventing data
acceptance: Original paper source remains attached
Voice capture produces editable job data where browser support exists
Uncertain extracted fields remain editable
No fabricated OCR result is presented as fact
constraints: Original evidence is the source of truth

objectives.title: Harden authentication identity and mutation recovery
acceptance: Engineer identity is used for mutations where supported
Important mutation failures show useful recovery states
Shared authenticated access remains intact
Build passes

objectives.title: Build the central compliance calendar and reminder view
acceptance: Central compliance dates are visible
Due-soon and overdue states are visible
60/30/14/7 day reminder configuration is represented safely
Mobile PWA workflow remains fast and usable
constraints: Do not fabricate reminders as sent

objectives.title: Harden public website stock presentation
acceptance: Public stock entries use verified KNT source data only
Unknown specifications, hours and prices remain explicitly unconfirmed
Stock records remain structured for future individual listing pages
constraints: Do not add guessed marketplace URLs
Keep stock data easy to replace with verified records

objectives.title: Improve KNT public website mobile conversion path
acceptance: Primary contact actions are obvious on mobile
Public/private app boundary remains clear
Website remains accessible and responsive
KNT branding remains consistent
constraints: Do not alter private app authentication

objectives.title: Harden fleet list loading, filtering and empty states
acceptance: Fleet list handles loading, empty and error states truthfully
Filtering does not lose forklift identity or status context
Mobile layout remains usable

objectives.title: Harden forklift detail history presentation
acceptance: Identity, site, status and history remain clearly separated
Missing records are represented honestly
Compliance and job history remain traceable
constraints: Do not invent history or compliance data

objectives.title: Harden jobsheet validation and save recovery
acceptance: Required job information is validated before save
Save failures remain recoverable
Evidence requirements are clear

objectives.title: Harden job detail evidence and completion states
acceptance: Evidence remains attached and visible
Job completion state is explicit
Failed mutations provide useful recovery

objectives.title: Harden shared data helpers and mutation errors
acceptance: Shared data helpers surface meaningful failures
Existing callers remain compatible
No silent destructive mutation path is introduced

objectives.title: Harden service and compliance interaction states
acceptance: Service and compliance actions expose loading and failure states
Due-date changes are explicit
Mobile engineer workflow remains usable

objectives.title: Harden parts and supplier interaction states
acceptance: Part and supplier mutations show clear success/failure states
Supplier evidence remains traceable
Empty states are truthful

objectives.title: Harden commercial review and invoice states
acceptance: Totals and VAT remain deterministic
Review state is obvious
Sending is never automatic

objectives.title: Harden authentication and app-level recovery UI
acceptance: Authentication failures are understandable
Loading and signed-out states are explicit
Existing authentication assumptions remain intact

objectives.title: Improve public website accessibility and responsive structure
acceptance: Primary public sections remain keyboard accessible
Responsive layout works across narrow screens
Contrast and focus treatment remain usable
Private /app boundary remains clear
